CC: News & Announcements (iOS)

Quick Reference Guide

| This Quick Reference Guide (QRG) shows how to locate News & Announcements in the PerfectServe Clinical Collaboration (CC) Mobile Application for iOS. |
| :---: |

| News & Announcements: The News & Announcements section provides the ability to broadcast information to specific users, departments, or to the entire account. Information shared in these feeds are typically informational and are not critical in nature.  Select News Select the message to view Select the sub-navigation menu icon in the top-right to manage alerts for any non-mandatory feeds in the News tab. Select the blue bell icon in the feed to turn alerts on/off for any non-mandatory feeds in the News tab.  Reminder: Alerts can only be turned on/off if the feed is nonmandatory.  |  *![][image1]*  |
